name: smwmusic-ys-iii-wanderers-from-ys-against-the-clock-seal-of-time-remix
title: Ys III: Wanderers from Ys - Against the Clock ~ Seal of Time (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of the Clock Tower section of Valestein Castle, Seal of Time from Ys III: Wanderers from Ys. Been quite some time since I've done a Ys III remix, and I thought I'd give it some spotlight again. This song, as I have stated in my previous Ys III remixes, definitely deserved better than what it got on the SNES.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled by default.

There are also two versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables the voice clip (No-Yoshi, No-Thunder)
2. Disables the voice clip (No-Thunder Only, turned on default)
